steps.hardClue: Defeat two flying enemies and return the flames to the central machine.
steps.clue: Defeat both Dread Skulls, return their Usurped Flames to the Nexus Forge, then crank both wheels.

steps.hardClue: Redirect the beam to open the hidden chamber.
steps.clue: Use the Astral Flame, then redirect the crystal beam and open Nyxara's Inner Sanctum.

steps.hardClue: Feed the growth, enter the hidden forest and recover three weapon parts from the bodies.
steps.clue: Feed the vine in Nyxara's Inner Sanctum, eat its fruit, then collect all three Warden's Blight parts.

steps.hardClue: Solve the pillar puzzle, enter the hidden room and assemble the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Solve the Dravakar pillar riddle, open the Inner Sanctum and forge the Warden's Blight.

steps.hardClue: Complete a coded evacuation and return to the starting location.
steps.clue: Exfil and return to Her House, then use a charged shot to reveal the Eye of the Forge.

steps.hardClue: Place the eye into a pedestal to upgrade the tactical device.
steps.clue: Place the Eye of the Forge into a grapple pedestal to create the Void Talon.

steps.hardClue: Use the upgraded tactical device to remove the seals.
steps.clue: Remove the Nexus seals, clear the exposed machinery, then Surge the Nexus and engage the gears.

steps.hardClue: Align the machine with each temple and complete all four cleansing rituals.
steps.clue: Align the Nexus with each temple and complete all four Shadowsmith cleansing rituals.

steps.hardClue: Stand on the circles beneath the central machine and descend.
steps.clue: Stand on the circles beneath the Nexus and descend into the Warden's arena.
